settings.info: Shown in the home header at 32×32. Leave empty to use the bundled OKA mark.

settings.info: The app opens in Arabic. Shoppers can switch at any time; their choice is remembered.

settings.label: Collections
settings.info: In order. These drive the home feed, the categories list, search, the edit-order sheet and the subscription builder — the app's CATS list.

settings.content: Estimates shown before checkout (cart bar, product page). Shopify's checkout always charges the store's own rate. Mirrors server/config/zones.js.

settings.info: 0 turns it off. The checkout button stays disabled below it.

settings.label: WhatsApp number
settings.info: International format, e.g. 201001234567. Powers the support button and order-change requests.

settings.label: Courier tracking page
settings.info: Used when a shipment has a tracking number but no tracking link (J&T's fulfillments arrive without one). Put {number} where the AWB goes, e.g. https://example.com/track?awb={number}. Without {number}, the button copies the AWB and opens the page.

settings.content: Order edit and cancel, live courier tracking, loyalty redemption and Subscribe & Save run on the OKA order service. Connect it through a Shopify App Proxy and enter the proxy path here (for example /apps/oka). Leave empty and those screens fall back to WhatsApp and Shopify's own account pages.

settings.label: J&T lookup panel (staff testing)
settings.info: Adds a panel to the Orders page that finds a customer's J&T shipments by phone, with the live scan history and the courier's Call / WhatsApp, straight from OKA's J&T connector on GCP. The tester types the connector token. Never turn this on in a published theme.

settings.label: J&T connector address (staff testing)
settings.info: The GCP connector's base URL, e.g. https://jt-mcp-server-xxxx.run.app — prefills the lookup panel. Not secret; the token is never stored in the theme.
